title: Review
summary: No new keys. Everything so far, longer and faster.
intro: This lesson teaches nothing new. It is the moment to check that what came before comes out without thinking, which is not the same as knowing where each key is.
congrats: Nothing new, and faster anyway. That is exactly what was supposed to happen.

screens.text: Single words to start. No rush: speed comes out of accuracy, never the other way round.
screens.content:
rest nose tone see
rises stores tire one
tear soon iron notes

screens.text: A short burst. Finish the list even if one gets away from you.
Five words to a line. Let your eyes run ahead of your fingers.
screens.content:
neat tear trees tears in
treat rear roots near to
son rain start tea test

screens.text: Patterns again, to check the fingers keep returning to the home row.
screens.content:
esa tri es
en ne enen
sss nnnn eeee tttt

screens.text: Short words at a good pace. These should almost type themselves by now.
screens.content:
in east star tears
start rain into so
tire no nose it

screens.text: More time and more words. Hold the same rhythm from start to finish.
Whole sentences. This is where you find out whether the hand goes home on its own.
screens.content:
set series rain rate
nose east start an
tear no rear root

screens.text: The last round. If you got here without looking at the keyboard, the lesson is done.
screens.content:
